access.title: No access to configuration
access.message: The Cortex Config panel requires administrator permissions.

agents.orgDescription: The global layer - it reaches every agent on the platform, before the department layers.
agents.orgPlaceholder:
e.g. Answer in English. Do not share personal data.
Name artifacts using the YYYYMMDD_name convention.
agents.deptDescription: A tile pinned to a department inherits the layers along its path: e.g. "finance/controlling" gets the "finance" rules, then "finance/controlling".
agents.noDepartments: No departments - add them in the resource catalog.
agents.deptPlaceholder: Rules inherited by tiles of the {{department}} department…
agents.order: Composition order: organization → departments (along the path) → tile instructions → user note.

assignmentEditor.description: A central email → role assignment; the first assignment turns open mode off.

catalog.departmentsDescription: The organization tree - paths like finance/controlling. Resources (skills, connectors, secrets) are assigned to departments, and projects pick branches.
catalog.sourcesDescription: A folder on disk → a department. Scanned into the catalog.
catalog.connectorsDescription: MCP and CLI per department. Secrets as credential refs.

connectorEditor.description: An agent tool: an MCP server or a CLI, with secrets passed by reference.
connectorEditor.connectionDescription: Secret values never reach the configuration - only references to paths in Secrets.

credentials.title: Credential store
credentials.description: Secrets for connectors and model keys (a key/subkey tree). Values are stored server-side and never come back to the browser - you can only overwrite them.

governance.openModeBody: nobody has a role assigned yet, so every user sees all tiles. Governance switches on with the first role assignment.
governance.adminsDescription: Who can open this panel. An empty list = anyone signed in (bootstrap mode).

projects.title: Agent projects
projects.description: Task-chat tiles configured centrally: model, skills per role, sandbox and artifact export.

catalog.title: Resource catalog
catalog.description: A department tree of skills, connectors and secrets - built centrally, picked in projects as building blocks.

agents.description: Hierarchical agent instructions: organization → departments → tile → user. You edit the admin layers here.

credentials.title: Secrets
credentials.description: Credential store: a key/subkey tree per department. Values are write-only - consumed through references in connectors and models.

governance.title: Roles and access
governance.description: Roles as access gates, user assignments and panel administrators.

projectEditor.description: A task-chat tile: model, access, building blocks from the catalog and a sandbox.
projectEditor.identityDescription: What the user sees on the hub.
projectEditor.accessDescription: A role is a gate: it decides who sees and opens the tile. The content is defined by the project's building blocks.
projectEditor.rolesEmpty: No roles defined - add them on the Roles and access tab.
projectEditor.modelDescription: Every turn goes through cortex-proxy - the server takes the gateway address from its own environment (CORTEX_PROXY_URL), so a project moves between instances without edits. Here you only pick the model.
projectEditor.apiKeyLabel: API key (a reference from Secrets, e.g. shared/llm/cortex-proxy)
projectEditor.apiKeyPlaceholder: empty = cortex-proxy does not verify the client key
projectEditor.skillsDescription: Build the project toolkit from catalog building blocks. A department branch pulls in every resource under it.
projectEditor.connectorsDescription: MCP and CLI that the agent gets as tools.
projectEditor.secretsDescription: A project may use only secrets from the granted branches/paths. This is the technical boundary between data zones.
projectEditor.briefsDescription: Ready-made jobs shown in an empty chat - clicking one fills the message box. The hint tells the user what they need to supply (e.g. a file with a transcript).
projectEditor.briefsEmpty: No briefs - the user will see an empty chat with no prompts.
projectEditor.briefTitlePlaceholder: e.g. Status pack from a transcript
projectEditor.briefHintPlaceholder: e.g. attach a file with the transcript
projectEditor.briefPromptPlaceholder: e.g. Build a status pack from the uploaded meeting transcript.
projectEditor.agentDescription: The tile inherits AGENTS.md: organization rules, then department rules along the department path, then the instructions below, and finally the user's private note.
projectEditor.systemPromptPlaceholder: e.g. Answer in English. Format reports to the department standard.
projectEditor.sandboxDescription: Where the agent does its work and which host paths it can see.
projectEditor.sandboxLocal: Local (directory isolation, runs on the host)
projectEditor.sandboxDocker: Docker (hard isolation, paths as bind mounts)
projectEditor.sandboxPathsLabel: Paths available in the sandbox (one per line, :ro suffix = read only)
projectEditor.exportDescription: An optional network share where the user drops a session file with one click.

projects.intro: Agent tiles (task-chat) configured centrally - every project is a separate hub tile with its own model, building blocks and sandbox.
projects.emptyDescription: Create the first agent tile for your department.
projects.deleteConfirm: Delete project "{{name}}"? Sessions and artifacts will stay on disk.

roleEditor.description: A role is an access gate - it decides who sees and opens tiles. The content is defined by the project's building blocks.

sourceEditor.description: A folder on disk scanned into the catalog; the skills land under the chosen department.
